statements.text: Two S-linked candidate genes were conserved: TSS1, tied to style length, and WDR-44, tied to anther height and pollen self-incompatibility.
statements.evidence: Two S-linked candidate genes, TSS1 (style length) and WDR-44 (anther height/pollen self-incompatibility), were conserved.
statements.note: The abstract names these two conserved S-linked candidates and the traits attached to them.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Epibrassinolide treatment produced a conserved, morph-specific effect on style length, and S-locus features stayed conserved for more than 30 million years in Linum.
statements.evidence: epibrassinolide treatment revealed a conserved, morph-specific effect on style length. S-locus structural polymorphism, candidate distyly genes and mechanisms regulating style length remain conserved > 30 Ma in Linum.
statements.note: The abstract reports the hormone effect and the conservation of S-locus features over more than 30 Ma.
